That's unrelated ("nine variants" of `PermissionResource`, not error codes) — doesn't need updating.

The shared `ErrorCode` union (`src/types/api.ts`) is the closed, nine-member type every Server Action and Route Handler funnels through via `toAppError()`/`toActionResult()` in `src/lib/errors.ts`. Adding a member requires:

1. **`src/types/api.ts`** — add the new literal to the `ErrorCode` union.
2. **`src/lib/errors.ts`** — `HTTP_STATUS_BY_CODE` is typed `Readonly<Record<ErrorCode, number>>`, so it won't compile until the new code gets an HTTP status; `toAppError()` also needs a branch that actually produces the new code from whatever new/existing thrown error it corresponds to.

Several docs treat "nine codes" as a closed, explicitly-enumerated list, and would misstate the contract the moment a tenth is added:

3. **`docs/adr/ADR-014-domain-errors-to-error-codes.md`** — states "exactly nine codes" and names all of them.
4. **`docs/design/data-flow.md`** (DES-025) — lists all nine codes verbatim.
5. **`docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md`** (DES-222) — says "matching one of the nine `ErrorCode` values."
6. **`docs/api/actions-overview.md`** — "The nine `ErrorCode` values..." plus a full status table.
7. **`docs/glossary.md`** — the "Error code" glossary entry spells out all nine.

ANSWER: src/types/api.ts, src/lib/errors.ts, docs/adr/ADR-014-domain-errors-to-error-codes.md, docs/design/data-flow.md, docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md, docs/api/actions-overview.md, docs/glossary.md
